metadata.description: QuantLib Tsiveriotis-Fernandes three-year zero-coupon convertible, at the money, 2% credit spread.
metadata.name: usd_convertible_tf_atm_3y_quantlib
metadata.source_detail: QuantLib 1.43 BinomialCRRConvertibleEngine (17536 steps) on a ConvertibleZeroCouponBond with American conversion and a flat credit spread of 0.02: spot 100.0, flat 0.3 volatility, 0.03 continuous dividend yield, flat 0.04 continuous Act/365F curve. The Finstack bond carries a flat 0.02 hazard curve with zero recovery, which is the same spread. The bond pays no coupon because QuantLib forfeits a coupon on conversion and Finstack retains it. Issuer calls and holder puts are not compared: on a cash redemption Finstack resets the conversion probability to zero, as the model's cash-only component requires, and QuantLib leaves it unchanged.

dv01.tolerance_reason: Both sides price the Tsiveriotis-Fernandes convertible on a binomial lattice: QuantLib at 17536 steps and Finstack at 1096 steps. The reference DV01 is a central difference over 10bp either side, per bp: QuantLib's lattice price is not smooth in the rate at 1bp, and its own 1bp DV01 moves by 1.6% between 1096, 4384 and 17536 steps, while the 10bp estimate is stable to 0.1%. Finstack's DV01 is a 1bp bump on a 1096-step lattice, so the bound is the 1bp estimator's dispersion.

npv.tolerance_reason: Both sides price the Tsiveriotis-Fernandes convertible on a binomial lattice: QuantLib at 17536 steps and Finstack at 1096 steps. With a credit spread QuantLib's lattice converges more slowly than the credit-free one: its at-the-money price moves by 2.1e-4 from 1096 to 4384 steps and 8.5e-5 from 4384 to 17536, so the reference is within about 1e-4 of its own limit. QuantLib compounds the blended rate simply per step and Finstack continuously, a difference of order one step.
